tagline.en: Microsoft's CogACT — a vision-language-action model that turns images and instructions into robot actions via a diffusion action head, released MIT.
tagline.zh: 微软 CogACT——一个视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,通过扩散式动作头把图像与指令转化为机器人动作,MIT 许可。

en: CogACT is a vision-language-action (VLA) model from Microsoft for robot control. It reads camera images and a language instruction and predicts robot actions, combining a Prismatic-style vision-language model (built on Llama-2 7B) with a diffusion transformer that generates the action sequence.

It comes in Small, Base, and Large sizes; the Base checkpoint is released under MIT. All the vision-language and action-head weights ship inside the CogACT checkpoints themselves — a gated Llama-2 mirror is only needed if no compatible local tokenizer is available.

In WorldFoundry, CogACT runs as an inference-only action model: give it an observation and an instruction, and it predicts the next actions for policy rollout. Training, data loaders, and deployment servers from the upstream project are out of scope here.
zh: CogACT 是微软推出的视觉-语言-动作(VLA)模型,用于机器人控制。它读取相机图像和一条语言指令,预测机器人动作——把 Prismatic 风格的视觉-语言模型(基于 Llama-2 7B)与生成动作序列的扩散 transformer 结合起来。
它提供 Small、Base、Large 三种规模,其中 Base checkpoint 以 MIT 许可发布。视觉-语言与动作头的权重都包含在 CogACT checkpoint 自身内;只有在本地没有兼容 tokenizer 时,才需要用到受限访问的 Llama-2 镜像。
在 WorldFoundry 中,CogACT 作为仅推理的动作模型运行:给它一帧观测和一条指令,它便预测接下来的动作用于策略推进(rollout)。上游项目中的训练、数据加载器与部署服务不在此范围内。

whenToUse.en: When you need a vision-language-action policy that maps camera observations and natural-language instructions to robot actions, and want an openly-available model with multiple size options.
whenToUse.zh: 当你需要一个把相机观测与自然语言指令映射为机器人动作的视觉-语言-动作策略,并希望使用开放、有多种规模可选的模型时。

notFor.en: This is a robot action policy, not a video or image generator. It focuses on action prediction and rollout; upstream training and real-world deployment servers are not part of the inference setup.
notFor.zh: 它是机器人动作策略,而非视频或图像生成器。它专注于动作预测与推进;上游的训练与真实部署服务不属于这里的推理配置。

en: Diffusion action head on a Prismatic Llama-2 7B VLM
Small, Base, and Large sizes; Base is MIT-licensed
Weights load from the CogACT checkpoint itself
zh: 面向机器人控制的视觉-语言-动作模型

提供 Small/Base/Large 规模,Base 为 MIT 许可
